attempts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for cozy anime pixel RPG, warm top-left light, dark brown tinted 1-2px outlines, chunky pixel clusters, large head and small feet, matching the reference. Genuine transparent background, NO text, NO grids, NO cast shadows, no ground. STRICT uniform grid FOUR columns THREE rows, 12 equal square cells. Row 0 FRONT, row 1 BACK (no face), row 2 right-facing SIDE. Each row shows the same four poses left to right in its own direction. Same character, clothes, accessories and proportions throughout. Feet baseline equal in each cell. Full body visible, ample transparent padding, nothing crosses cell boundaries. Output 4:3 aspect ratio. Reference leaftail.png is the exact same pet: little green leaf fox-cat, cream face/chest, huge leaf tail, leaf crest, tan paws/ears. Preserve its size about 68 drawn pixels in final 96 square cell. Columns: 0 crouch before pounce; 1 leaping strike with leaf tail whipping forward; 2 hurt flinch; 3 fainted lying down with swirl eyes. Back has no visible face. No teal.
